verdict.rationale: Mem0 exposes core memory operations (add, search, update, delete, graph memory, entity scoping, expiration, export, webhooks) via a documented REST API/OpenAPI spec, and the CLI/dashboard appear to be thin wrappers over the same API, suggesting broad parity. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm every dashboard feature (e.g., audit log viewing, webhook configuration UI, per-user API key management) has a direct API equivalent, nor is there independent/hands-on confirmation of full UI-API parity. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that dashboard-only features (audit logs, key management UI) are also API-accessible, and independent verification of full parity beyond vendor docs.
